title: EDITEVAL: An Instruction-Based Benchmark for Text Improvements

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating a language model's ability to edit and rewrite sentences to remove subjective language and opinions (adhering to a Neutral Point of View). This is measured using the Wiki Neutrality Corpus (WNC)—a dataset of biased and de-biased sentence pairs from Wikipedia edits—and scored using Exact Match (EM) and SARI metrics.
